full.label: Full
full.hint: Built-in microphone, headset, speakers. The browser removes noise and echo and evens out the volume.

light.label: Light
light.hint: A good microphone without headphones. Only the speaker echo is removed; your voice stays as is.

off.label: No processing
off.hint: Studio microphone and headphones. Sound goes out as is, in higher quality.

noiseSuppression.hint: Removes hum, keyboard and fan noise — but also breathing and quiet word endings.

echoCancellation.hint: Keeps the room's sound from your speakers out of the microphone.

autoGainControl.hint: Evens out the volume. On a good microphone the volume “drifts” between phrases.

highQuality.label: High transmission quality
highQuality.hint: Cleaner sound, quiet word beginnings aren’t cut off.

delivery.title: How you get the service
delivery.digital: The service is digital and is provided online through your account on this website. There is no physical delivery — nothing needs to be sent or received.
delivery.account: You can pay for a plan after signing up and confirming your email with the link we send: receipts and payment reminders go to that address.
delivery.instant: Access to the paid plan opens automatically right after the payment is confirmed, usually within a minute. No email or call is needed.
delivery.term: The service is provided for the whole paid period: a calendar month or year from the date of payment.
delivery.requirements: You need a browser and streaming software with a browser source, such as OBS Studio. Nothing from us needs to be installed.

payment.title: Payment and refunds
payment.methods: Pay by bank card, via SBP (Faster Payments System), SberPay, T-Pay or YooMoney on the secure YooKassa payment page.
payment.card: Card details are entered on the YooKassa side and are never passed to us. The receipt is issued automatically at the time of payment.
payment.renewal: The plan renews automatically using the saved payment method. We email you about every charge at least three days in advance. You can turn off renewal with one button in the Plan section — access stays until the end of the paid period.
payment.refund: You can cancel the plan at any time: we refund the remaining full days of the period within 10 days of your email to the support address in the Contacts section. See the paid plans offer for details.
